title: Checkout App: Self-checkout sales flow
description: Split proposal C: mixed (HRP-727). Holds the settings of one touchpoint. Prototype: not registered in CCC, so it renders but cannot be saved. Proposed IAM role: checkout-sco-flow-editor.

rescan.title: SSLP Rescan Rules
rescan.description: Settings for the rescan functionality in attendable SCO mode.

indicateScanStatus.title: Indicate Scan Status
indicateScanStatus.description: Toggles the indication of the item scan status, e.g. quantity mismatch.

clearBasketOnSwitch.title: Clear Basket on Switch to Full Rescan
clearBasketOnSwitch.description: Resets the scanning basket when a partial rescan switches to full rescan mode, manually or automatically.

layout.title: Receipt
layout.description: This is a definition of the receipt layout settings.

identifierType.title: Item Identifier Type
identifierType.description: The type of the identifier to be displayed in the receipt.

visibleAttributes.title: Visible Item Attributes
visibleAttributes.description: Toggles visibility of the listed item attributes in the receipt.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.description: This is a definition of the SCO schedule settings.

logoutTimeout.title: Logout Timeout (minutes)
logoutTimeout.description: The number of minutes after which the SCO will log out even if it has an ongoing transaction.

items.description: Schedule settings for the corresponding period of week.

enabled.title: Enable Bag Selection Screen
enabled.description: Enables the bags screen in SCO mode.

items.description: Defines the bag types available in SCO mode.

ean.title: EAN
ean.description: Defines the EAN of the bag.

title.title: Title
title.description: Defines the name of the bag.

imageUrl.title: Image URL
imageUrl.description: Defines the image URL of the bag.

itemDetails.title: Item details
itemDetails.description: Settings for the item details view in SCO mode.

voidItemEnabled.title: Void item enabled
voidItemEnabled.description: Shows the 'Remove from receipt' button in the item details panel.

keyboardOverrides.title: Keyboard overrides
keyboardOverrides.description: Defines specific prompt codes that override the default keyboard type.

items.description: Specifies the keyboard type override for the corresponding prompt code.

keyboardType.title: Keyboard type
keyboardType.description: Specifies the keyboard type override for the corresponding prompt code.

whitelistedPrompts.title: Whitelisted Prompts
whitelistedPrompts.description: List of prompt codes and whether each one is whitelisted in SCO mode.

id.title: ID
id.description: The prompt code to whitelist, will act as an identifier.

whitelisted.title: Whitelisted
whitelisted.description: Indicates if the prompt is whitelisted or not.

enabled.title: Enable PLU
enabled.description: Enables the PLU in SCO mode.

shortcutsEnabled.title: Enable PLU Shortcuts
shortcutsEnabled.description: Allows PLU shortcut items to be set in the main view of SCO mode.

enabled.title: Enable Loyalty Card
enabled.description: Enables the loyalty card feature in SCO mode.

countryCodePrefix.title: Loyalty Card Country Code Prefix
countryCodePrefix.description: Defines the loyalty card prefix in SCO mode.

cardReminderEnabled.title: Enable Card Reminder Dialog
cardReminderEnabled.description: Enables the loyalty card reminder dialog in SCO mode.

cardReminderTriggers.title: Card reminder triggers
cardReminderTriggers.description: Defines when to show the loyalty card reminder dialog in SCO mode.

startTrip.title: Trigger at Trip Start
startTrip.description: Triggers the loyalty card reminder straight after the trip starts in SCO mode.

startPayment.title: Trigger at Payment Start
startPayment.description: Triggers the loyalty card reminder when the 'Pay' button is clicked in SCO mode.

cardReminderMediaContent.title: Card reminder media content
cardReminderMediaContent.description: Defines the media content of the loyalty card reminder dialog in SCO mode.

type.title: Reminder Media Type
type.description: The type of the media content shown in the loyalty card reminder dialog.

sourceUrl.title: Reminder Media Source URL
sourceUrl.description: The direct source URL of the media file (.jpg/.png for images, .mp4 for video).

enabled.title: Enable Loyalty QR Info
enabled.description: Enables the SCO loyalty QR info feature.

data.title: Loyalty QR Code Data URL
data.description: Loyalty info data (URL) to be encoded in the QR code.

manualSearchEnabled.title: Enable Manual Barcode Search
manualSearchEnabled.description: Enables the manual search (by barcode) shortcut in SCO mode.

callAssistantEnabled.title: Enable Call Assistant
callAssistantEnabled.description: Enables the call assistant button in SCO mode.

decreaseEnabled.title: Allow Quantity Decrease
decreaseEnabled.description: Allows an item's quantity to be decreased in SCO mode.

spotCheckEnabled.title: Show Spot Check Message
spotCheckEnabled.description: Enables the spot check message on the SCO welcome screen.

paymentMenuSettings.title: Payment menu settings
paymentMenuSettings.description: Payment menu settings in SCO mode.

items.description: Settings for a payment menu command in SCO mode.

imageUrl.title: Image URL
imageUrl.description: URL of the image to be displayed in the payment menu.
